items.coder_A: has_eligible_candidate false, excluded_intervention_type (uncertain: oncolytic-virus nature inferred)
items.reason: The record never names the product type, but every detail fits a live (polio-based) oncolytic virus. It is dosed in infectious units ('Cohort 1 (5×10⁶ CCID₅₀, n=20)'), there are 'Viral shedding' outcomes, and entry requires a 'boost immunization with trivalent inactivated poliovirus vaccine' with neutralising titre. That makes it an oncolytic virus, an excluded intervention type.

items.coder_B: excluded_intervention_type (uncertain: record never states what JL15003 is)
items.reason: Same evidence: CCID50 dosing and viral shedding in 'blood', 'throat swab' and 'fecal samples' can only describe a replicating virus. A non-viral pharmacological agent would not be dosed or monitored this way.

note: The identity of JL15003 is inferred, not stated. Confirming it from sponsor material (Jecho Biopharmaceuticals) would raise confidence but is outside the record. Priority-3 agent naming: under W2, a short generic name such as 'oncolytic poliovirus' is preferred. Listing the inactivated poliovirus vaccine boost (coder A) as excluded_intervention_type is acceptable, since every patient receives it as a registered prerequisite. Virus copy number in CSF and cyst fluid is shedding of a non-candidate, so tumour_pk_planned is 'no'.
